text:
Ava Lynn: Heads up — proposing a planned maintenance for kv-compaction in eu-west on Tue 2026-04-05 02:00-03:00 UTC. Expected impact: brief read-only serving for a subset of routers (~15-25m) and momentary embed latency increase. Draft status page + customer copy below. Please review.

Jon Park: Ack. Can we shorten to 02:00-03:00 instead of 02:00-04:00? Customer ops asked to avoid a longer window. I can be primary on-call for the window. @Priya can you confirm runbook timing?

Priya Singh: I can trim the work: stagger compactions across router groups, preflight checks: 02:00-02:15, compaction 02:15-02:45, validation 02:45-03:00. That should keep user-facing readonly to a single 15m block. I'll update the runbook and add rollback steps.

Marta Gomez: Ops note: need 30m preflight for cert checks if we rotate keys; otherwise ok. Can we include a short-step list in the status page? Also request SRE-Bot to set pager for 02:00.

incident-bot: Scheduled maintenance created — ID maint-2026-342. Notifying oncall: Jon Park. Status page will be auto-updated at 60 minutes before start.

Ava Lynn: Pasting suggested status page message (please keep edits minimal):

```
We will perform a planned maintenance in eu-west to compact KV routers on Tue 2026-04-05 from 02:00 to 03:00 UTC.
Impact: brief read-only period (~15 minutes) for a subset of serving routers; embedding and generation latency may be elevated for a short period.
Customer impact: no data loss expected. Applications should continue to return responses; you may see transient increased latency or short read-only errors.
We will monitor closely and post updates here.
```

Ava Lynn: Customer email draft:

```
Subject: Planned maintenance — eu-west KV compact (Apr 5)

Hi —
We are scheduling a short maintenance window on Apr 5 at 02:00-03:00 UTC to perform backend compaction in eu-west. You may experience a brief read-only period (~15 minutes) and slight latency increases for embeddings during this time. No data loss is expected.

If this window conflicts with your workloads, reply and we can discuss alternatives. We'll post live updates on our status page and notify once complete.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Operations
```

Jon Park: I like the shorter messaging. I'll own the live bridge and status updates. I'll also trigger the 15m pre-start ping. :thumbsup:

Priya Singh: Added rollback steps to runbook and a quick verification checklist to post after completion.

SRE-Bot: Pager schedule updated for maint-2026-342: primary Jon Park, secondary Priya Singh.

Ava Lynn: Final plan: window 02:00-03:00 UTC, staggered compaction as described. I'll publish status page now and queue customer email to send 24h and 2h before start. If no objections, I'll post the announcement.

Marta Gomez: LGTM.

Jon Park: LGTM, thanks everyone.
